title: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, CAS Specialists and Senior Residents
age_limit: Below 69 years for faculty; 45 to 50 years for Senior Residents depending on specialty
summary: Government Medical College, Rajanna Sircilla has announced a notification for walk-in interviews to fill 44 vacancies for Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, CAS Specialists, and Senior Residents on a contract and honorarium basis. Eligible candidates with required medical qualifications and registrations can attend the walk-in interview on 26.11.2026 along with filled application forms and original certificates.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess MBBS and corresponding Post Graduate Degree/Diploma (MD/MS/DNB/M.Sc/Ph.D) in the relevant specialty as per NMC regulations.
Must be registered with the Telangana State Medical Council (non-local candidates must register within one week of selection).
Fulfill required teaching and research experience as per NMC guidelines for respective teaching posts.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official website https://gmcrajannasircilla.org/
Fill in the application form accurately and attach attested photocopies of required documents including educational and experience certificates.
Attend the walk-in interview on 26.11.2026 at the MEU Hall, First floor, Government Medical College, Rajanna Sircilla with the filled application form and all original certificates.
